name: Vangi Bath
summary: Karnataka-style brinjal rice with capsicum and vangi bath powder.

items: 1⅓ standard cups sona masuri rice (1 rice cup)
250 g small round purple brinjal, sliced

preparation.text: Rinse 1⅓ standard cups sona masuri rice (1 rice cup).

items: 250 g small round purple brinjal, sliced
preparation.after: Keep the sliced brinjal in water until needed to prevent discolouration.

items: 1⅓ standard cups sona masuri rice (1 rice cup)
cookingMethod.after: Build pressure, reduce to 100°C / 300 W for 10 minutes and allow natural pressure release. Spread the cooked rice gently so it does not become mushy.

cookingMethod.lead: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a wide kadai. Add:
cookingMethod.after: Allow the tempering ingredients to sizzle.

cookingMethod.text: Add 1 medium onion (about 120 g), sliced, and sauté until softened.

items: 250 g small round purple brinjal, sliced
cookingMethod.after: Cook covered until the brinjal is tender while retaining its shape.

cookingMethod.text: Add 3½ tablespoons vangi bath powder and mix on low heat for 1–2 minutes.
Add the cooked rice gradually and fold gently until evenly coated.
Turn off the heat and finish with the juice of 1 small lemon.

servingSuggestions: Serve with plain curd, cucumber raita or potato chips.
notes: This version uses 250 g brinjal and 100 g capsicum.
Add lemon only after turning off the heat, especially when the vangi bath powder tastes slightly flat or old.
